skill.metric.combined.title: Skill estimate
skill.metric.combined.hint: All the metrics below, weighted for each race; none counts for less than a tenth or more than three tenths of it.
skill.metric.eapm.title: Effective actions per minute
skill.metric.eapm.hint: Actions that change the game; spam is not counted.
skill.metric.used_recalls_per_min.title: Hotkey recalls put to use
skill.metric.used_recalls_per_min.hint: Selecting a control group with its number key, then giving it an order. A double tap counts once.
skill.metric.army_cadence.title: Army production rhythm
skill.metric.army_cadence.hint: Share of 10 second stretches in which the player started an army unit.
skill.metric.production_idle_share.title: Idle production
skill.metric.production_idle_share.hint: Share of time army buildings stood idle. Zerg: larva left waiting, out of the 3 each hatchery holds.
skill.metric.idle_army_share.title: Idle army
skill.metric.idle_army_share.hint: Share of the army's value, from 8:00, standing on one spot with no orders for 20 seconds or more, wherever a rally point left it. Sieged tanks and Lurkers are left out.
skill.metric.micro_actions_per_min.title: Micro actions
skill.metric.micro_actions_per_min.hint: Unit abilities used per minute from 2:00: Hold Position, unloading, sieging, Stim Packs, cloaking, merging Archons and casting spells. Pressing the same ability again within a second counts once.
skill.status.tooShort: Games shorter than 8 minutes are not rated.
skill.status.unavailable: Skill is not available for this game.
skill.footnote: Tiers come from over 3,000 ladder games with known MMR: Beginner under 1,400, Intermediate 1,400 to 1,799, Advanced 1,800 and up, Pro for progamers. Army production rhythm, idle production and micro actions compare each race with itself; the other metrics use one scale for every race.
skill.status.customRules: Custom rules games are not rated.
skill.caveat: ⚠️ Tiers are calibrated on non-money 1v1 games; team games and money maps distort the metrics, so expect some unreliable verdicts.
skill.explain.title: How Skill works
skill.explain.intro: Skill guesses the tier someone played at in one game. It looks at how they played, never at who won.
skill.explain.corpus.title: Learned from ladder games
skill.explain.corpus.body: Built from {games} 1v1 ladder games where every player's MMR was known, plus progamer games.
skill.explain.race.title: Fair across races
skill.explain.race.body: Each player is compared only with their own race, which has its own tier lines and weights.
skill.explain.picked.title: Only metrics that track MMR
skill.explain.picked.body: Each metric is in because it rises or falls with MMR in those games. Others were tested and dropped.
skill.explain.metrics.title: The six metrics
skill.explain.follows.note: How closely each metric follows MMR, from 0 to 1. Around 0.5 or more is a strong signal.
skill.explain.weights.title: How much each metric counts
skill.explain.weights.body: The estimate is a weighted average. Each metric counts for 10% to 30%, so no single one decides the tier.
skill.explain.oneGame.title: One game is a rough guess
skill.explain.oneGame.body: It gets the exact tier right about 6 times in 10. An average over many games is steadier.
skill.pill.no_hotkeys.hint: In {games} of {of} games: under one hotkey recall a minute.
skill.pill.never_checks_hotkeys.hint: In {games} of {of} games: uses hotkeys to give orders but almost never just to look at a group.
skill.pill.hotkey_cycler.hint: In {games} of {of} games: 100 or more hotkey checks a minute, a habit of strong players.
skill.pill.nonstop_production.hint: In {games} of {of} games: started army units in more than half of all 10 second stretches.
skill.pill.banks_resources.hint: In {games} of {of} games: usually sat on a full minute of income or more.
